semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Neumo GmbH & Co. KG provides components that are essential for maintaining ultra-high purity environments in semiconductor fabs.
summary: Neumo GmbH & Co. KG specializes in the development and manufacturing of stainless steel tubes, hygienic fittings, and customized parts used in ultra-high purity media applications. Their products are critical for semiconductor fabrication processes, ensuring the integrity of the environments where semiconductor devices are produced.
capabilities: Stainless steel tubes for ultra-high purity applications

regional_presence.Germany: The company is headquartered in Knittlingen, Germany, where it has established a significant manufacturing presence.
